probes.name: columns_count
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet, s As String, one As Range, r As Long, c As Long
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
For r = 1 To 6
    For c = 1 To 6
        ws.Cells(r, c).Value = "'" & ws.Cells(r, c).Address(False, False)
    Next
Next
On Error Resume Next
Err.Clear

If Err.Number <> 0 Then
    s = "E" & Err.Number
Else
    Err.Clear
    s = CStr(ws.Range("A1:C3").Columns.Count)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = "E" & Err.Number
End If
On Error GoTo 0
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
ws.Delete
Application.DisplayAlerts = True
Probe = s
End Function
